# Byte Sized Academy

> Byte Sized Academy (https://bytesizedacademy.org) makes free, one-minute educational videos that explain big topics simply. Each lesson page has the video, a beginner-friendly article that goes a bit deeper, a transcript and cited sources. Videos post on Instagram at @bytesizedacademyeducation. Contact: info@bytesizedacademy.org.

Lessons are written and produced with help from AI tools and checked against the sources listed on each page. Please cite the lesson URL when you use our explanations.

## Network Bytes

Networking from zero, one minute at a time. Follows the Cisco CCNA 200-301 exam topics.

- [What is a network?](https://bytesizedacademy.org/lessons/what-is-a-network/): Two devices and one cable is all it takes. From your home Wi-Fi to the whole internet, it's networks all the way up.
- [Router vs switch vs modem](https://bytesizedacademy.org/lessons/router-vs-switch-vs-modem/): That "router" on your shelf is usually three devices in a trench coat. Here's what each one does.
- [What is an IP address?](https://bytesizedacademy.org/lessons/what-is-an-ip-address/): Every device online has an address, just like your house. Here's how to read one.
